parcel.what: Order alert list: Parcel card, Accept
Go to Pickup Zone map → Inside the Pickup Zone; swipe ARRIVED (blue). No order ID / earnings on parcel map.
Collect Parcel: OTP strip, 'Please collect payment ₹130', pickup details, items + restricted-items consent, Upload Photo (Compulsory), swipe PICKED (never disabled).

Photo: camera permission → capture (mandatory: red 'Photo is compulsory' panel; optional: instructions only) → Retry/Submit → 'Uploading, Please wait…'.
    Branch A (mandatory, photo first): tap Upload → camera → back to 1:3157 (Upload successful) → swipe PICKED → payment.
    Branch B (mandatory, not uploaded): swipe PICKED → camera opens directly → compulsory sheet → payment directly (skips 1:3157).
    Branch C (optional): camera only if captain taps Upload; swipe PICKED → payment.
Payments: amount ₹130, Generate QR → QR shown, or Collect Cash.
'Amount Collected Successfully' card → opens OTP directly.
Enter Pickup OTP (heading to become 'Complete pickup') → Please wait.
Perfect Pick-up! + Use Rapido Maps sheet → Go to drop map / turn-by-turn; swipe REACHED (red).
Complete Delivery details: 'Amount collected online', drop + pickup details, items, Drop Off Notes, Upload Photo, swipe DELIVERED.
Same image upload flow → photo uploaded.
If OTP required: Enter Drop OTP → Please wait. If not: skip.
Order Complete: amount collected, rate Good/Bad, chips, Done. Could reuse bike end-of-order screen.

food.what: Order alert list (current app): Delivery cards, Accept with 19s ring.
Go to Pickup Zone map with Order ID band, 'Estimated Earnings ₹30 + wait charge', 43-min ring; swipe ARRIVED.
Collect Parcel at restaurant. With prep time + wait charge (1:3044: wait timer disabled, 'Food will be ready in 21:30') or without (1:3138: earnings only).
Prep time over: wait timer active, 'Slight delay in food prep…'. When 4 mins are over: 'You are now earning wait charges' (timer counts up).
Food ready: 'Food order is Ready!' banner, timer inactive, Upload Photo (Compulsory); centred pop-up 'Food is Ready!' + Okay.
Same photo flow and photo rules as parcel → Upload successful → swipe PICKED. No payment, no pickup OTP.
Shared drop navigation (same as parcel steps 8–9).
Complete Delivery: Swiggy + drop details with Call customer / Go to location, items, Upload Photo → same image upload flow; swipe DELIVERED.
OTP not required → Order Complete (OTP branch 1:3278 applies if required).

patternCandidates.name: Trip map: go to pickup / drop
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain is travelling to a pickup or drop point.
patternCandidates.structure: Top header (menu, stage title 'Go to Pickup Zone' / 'Inside the Pickup Zone' / 'Go to drop', call) > [food only: black Order ID band + green Estimated Earnings band] > full map (stop pin by service, route, ETA ring, recenter) > floating yellow 'Go to pickup/drop' pill > white stop card (pin, name, address) > full-width swipe (ARRIVED / REACHED)
patternCandidates.variations: Parcel hides order ID and earnings; food shows both + countdown ring. Swipe colour blue (pickup) vs red (drop).
patternCandidates.conflicts: Swipe colours blue/red/black; header has hamburger instead of Runway Internal Page Header.

patternCandidates.name: Order stage page (Collect / Complete delivery)
patternCandidates.whenToUse: At the pickup or drop: show everything needed to finish the stage and one swipe to confirm.
patternCandidates.structure: Top header (stage title, call) > [order ID row] > status strip(s) (orange 'requires an OTP', red delay) > status card (yellow 'Please collect payment ₹X' / green 'Amount collected online' / green 'Food order is Ready!') > [earnings + wait timer card] > collapsible Pickup Details card and Drop Details card (name, address, yellow Call customer + outline Go to location; partner chip e.g. Swiggy) > Items card (checkbox + qty + restricted-items consent) > [Drop Off Notes field] > Upload Photo tile (Compulsory tag) > sticky swipe (PICKED / DELIVERED)
patternCandidates.variations: Parcel vs food; with/without timers; photo compulsory or optional; pickup details expanded/collapsed; uploaded photo with Delete.
patternCandidates.conflicts: Swipe never disabled even when photo compulsory; inconsistent payment status between 1:3241 and 1:3255; 'Drop Off Notes' vs 'Drop off notes'.

patternCandidates.name: Proof-of-delivery photo with mandatory/optional rule
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Package photo at pickup or drop.
patternCandidates.structure: Upload tile on stage page > camera (no frame box) > bottom instruction panel (mandatory: red title 'Photo is compulsory for this order') > Retry | Submit > 'Uploading, Please wait…' card > back to page with green 'Upload successful' snackbar + photo + Delete Photo. Mandatory + not uploaded: swiping opens camera directly then continues.
patternCandidates.variations: Mandatory vs optional; labelled vs unlabelled preview buttons.
patternCandidates.conflicts: Instructions panel is a fixed panel, not a dismissable sheet.

patternCandidates.name: OTP entry page
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Handover needs a 4-digit code from sender/receiver.
patternCandidates.structure: Header (back, 'Complete pickup' / 'Complete Delivery', call) > black band: Order ID + Sender/Receiver name > 'Enter Pickup/Drop OTP' + 4 boxes > helper 'Please ask customer for OTP' > numeric keyboard (✓ submits) > 'Please wait…' card
patternCandidates.variations: Pickup vs drop; optional by order ('This order requires an OTP' strip on stage page).
patternCandidates.conflicts: Title truncates ('Complete package pick…', R02); no on-screen submit or resend.

patternCandidates.name: Wait timer and food prep countdown
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Captain waits at restaurant; show when food is ready and when wait charge starts.
patternCandidates.structure: Green earnings header '₹30 + wait charge' + white body: Wait Timer mm:ss + info line ('After 4 mins, you will get extra waiting charge' → 'You are now earning wait charges') ; separate card 'Please Wait! Food will be ready in' + flip-digit mm:ss; red delay strip when overdue; replaced by green 'Food order is Ready!' banner
patternCandidates.variations: Disabled / active / earning / inactive; without prep time.

patternCandidates.name: Payment collection at pickup
patternCandidates.structure: Payments header + ? > amount card + yellow 'not your final earning' note > QR section (Generate QR → generating → QR) > OR > yellow Collect Cash > centred 'Amount Collected Successfully' card, auto-advances to OTP
patternCandidates.conflicts: Success card has no button or × (R11).

patternCandidates.name: Food is ready pop-up
patternCandidates.whenToUse: Restaurant marks food ready while captain waits.
patternCandidates.structure: Scrim > centred card: illustration with green check > 'Food is Ready!' > one line > yellow small 'Okay'

patternCandidates.name: Navigation choice sheet after pickup
patternCandidates.structure: Sheet with green tinted top (illustration, 'Perfect Pick-up!') > icon > 'Use Rapido Maps' + body > outline 'No, thanks' + yellow 'Go To Maps'

patternCandidates.name: End of order with feedback
patternCandidates.structure: Header 'Order Complete' + ? > card (green check, 'Amount Collected Online', not-final-earning note, drop distance) > 'How was your ride?' Good/Bad > chips > sticky yellow Done; black strip 'Complete the feedback to start next order'
patternCandidates.conflicts: 'How was your ride?' copy on a delivery.

patternCandidates.name: Parcel order alert in side-tab list
patternCandidates.structure: 'N Orders' header > side tab rail | order cards: service chip 'Parcel'/'Delivery', fare, illustration, pickup/drop km + address, reject ring + yellow Accept
patternCandidates.variations: Pink themed second card; current-app card with Pickup/Drop km split.

againstConfirmed.candidate: Trip map: go to pickup / drop
againstConfirmed.detail: No trip-map pattern exists. Swipe CTA agrees with D02 (bike = swipe). Conflicts: header has hamburger, not Runway Internal Page Header (D06); swipe colours blue/red/black, not yellow (D05 applies to buttons — needs a call on swipe colour).

Closest is P02 Document upload page (upload tile + sticky footer) and P21 consent line. Conflicts: D06 (non-Runway 'Top header'); D13 ('Swiggy' hand-made chip and red '(Compulsory)' text outside a ChecklistCard); R09 (all components from a legacy library). Status strips match P25 inline banners (orange/red). 'Upload successful' green snackbar agrees with D11.

againstConfirmed.verdict: Matches P03 Camera capture → preview → verify
againstConfirmed.detail: Same capture → Retry/Submit → status card; differs: no Gallery, no verify step (upload only), 'Uploading, Please wait…' = P16. Instruction panel is fixed, not a sheet, so D09/R11 do not apply. Mandatory title red agrees with D12 spirit. Header is plain back arrow, not dark Internal Page Header (D06).
No OTP pattern. Conflicts: legacy header (D06); title truncation (R02); 'Please wait' card matches P16.

againstConfirmed.candidate: Wait timer and food prep countdown
againstConfirmed.detail: Shares status-card idea with P45 Progress tracker card but is a timer; no conflict found. Red delay strip = P25.

Same header/QR/OR/Collect Cash. Differs: P11 ends with confirm sheet (Go back / Collected); here a centred 'Amount Collected Successfully' card (P17) with no button or × — conflicts R11; D03 allows centred card for short success.

againstConfirmed.verdict: Matches P17 Success card on dim background
againstConfirmed.detail: Centred card, check badge, title + line, Okay; agrees with D03 (short success = centred card) and D05 (yellow). Has no ×, but has Okay so R11 is met.

againstConfirmed.verdict: Matches P18 Outcome sheet with tinted header (loosely)
againstConfirmed.detail: Tinted green top + two CTAs (yellow forward, white secondary) agrees with D05 and D03 (decision = sheet). Conflicts D09: no floating ×.
Stamp/check → amount → distance → one feedback question + chips → sticky Done. Agrees with D05.

againstConfirmed.candidate: Parcel order alert in side-tab list
againstConfirmed.verdict: Matches P34 Order list with side tabs + P33 card
againstConfirmed.detail: Conflicts D10: cards are legacy (1:2981) or local (1:2784), not on the OA framework; Specifics ask to reuse the bike card and only change the icon. No bottom nav shown, so D14 not tested.

openQuestions: Swipe CTA colour: blue ARRIVED, black PICKED/DELIVERED, red REACHED. Which colour should the Runway swipe use given D05 (yellow primary)?
Specifics 1:3340 says pickup details collapsed on 1:3044, but the frame shows them expanded. Which is right?
Specifics 1:3324 says order ID was added to Collect Parcel (1:3148), but the frame has no order-ID row. Missing from the design?
1:3227/1:3241 show 'Amount collected online' but 1:3255 shows 'Please collect payment ₹130' for the same parcel drop. Is there a pay-on-delivery case?
Mandatory photo + swipe Picked without photo: rule says go camera → payment directly, skipping the 'Upload successful' page. Should the captain see the uploaded state at all?
Food flow has no payment and no pickup OTP; drop OTP 'when required'. Who decides OTP per order?
